cards.title: Much / many / a lot
cards.body: How much quantity? The noun type matters: countable vs uncountable. many + countable plural · much + uncountable · a lot of + both.
cards.body_cz: Kolik? Záleží na typu podstatného jména: počitatelná vs nepočitatelná. many + počitatelná mn. · much + nepočitatelná · a lot of + oboje.
points: a lot of = safe for both

cards.title: After a negative
cards.body: After don't / didn't / isn't use anybody / anything / anywhere — not nobody / nothing. English has one negative.
cards.body_cz: Po don't / didn't / isn't → anybody / anything / anywhere — ne nobody / nothing. V angličtině jeden zápor.

cards.title: Questions
cards.body: How many + countable plural. How much + uncountable (or price).
cards.body_cz: How many + počitatelná mn. číslo. How much + nepočitatelná (nebo cena).

cards.title: Negatives
cards.body: In negative sentences, much and many are common. In positive sentences, a lot of is often more natural.
cards.body_cz: V záporu se často používá much / many. V kladné větě je a lot of často přirozenější.
points: In + sentences a lot of is common

cards.title: a few / a little
cards.title_cz: a few / a little — pár / trochu
cards.body: a few + countable plural. a little + uncountable. Small amount with a positive feel.
cards.body_cz: a few + počitatelná mn. a little + nepočitatelná. Malé množství (spíš kladně).
points: a few questions · a little sugar

cards.title: too much / too many
cards.body: too much + uncountable. too many + countable plural. too = more than we want.
cards.body_cz: too much + nepočitatelná. too many + počitatelná mn. too = víc, než chceme.

cards.title: Practice focus
cards.body: The gap is the quantifier. Look at the noun: countable plural or uncountable?
cards.body_cz: Doplňuješ quantifier. Dívej se na podstatné jméno: počitatelná mn., nebo nepočitatelná?
points: Look at the noun: countable plural vs uncountable
a lot of is safe when unsure

cards.title: Remember
cards.body: many + countable plural · much + uncountable · a lot of + both.
cards.body_cz: many + počitatelná mn. · much + nepočitatelná · a lot of + oboje.
points: a lot of / lots of + both
a few / a little = small positive amount
